subject: FRMT kickoff — dialect quality as a launch gate
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kickoff for the FRMT workstream. FRMT is our benchmark for region-aware machine translation: a few thousand English Wikipedia sentences human-translated into Brazilian vs European Portuguese and Mainland vs Taiwan Mandarin. The clever part is the bucket design — the lexical bucket targets terms that translate differently by region, and the entity bucket is adversarial: a model should not switch to Portugal Portuguese just because Lisbon is mentioned.

Product framing: this becomes the dialect-quality gate for our translation features. Milestones: baseline evals by Mar 20, regional quality dashboard by Apr 24, Launch Review Board on May 15.

Milan, Vera and Yara are assigned. Ivo — staffing and budget when you can.

Priya
